title: Beyond testmetest: Native Addon Camouflage and 42 Armed GitHub Repositories Reveal a Hidden npm Publisher
content: Security researchers identified a sophisticated supply chain attack campaign involving 42 compromised GitHub repositories across 11 legitimate owners connected to the testmetest npm operation. The campaign evolved to use compiled native addons that decrypt hidden payloads at runtime, evading detection in CI environments through extensive anti-analysis checks. Attackers deployed polymorphic... This pulse includes 11 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: Shai-Hulud, Miasma.

title: ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group Linked to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
content: A threat cluster designated O-UNC-053, previously linked to the ShinyHunters extortion crew, appears to have rebranded under the name INCEPTION. The group conducts voice phishing attacks to harvest credentials and bypass multi-factor authentication through social engineering tactics. Targeted industries: Technology, Healthcare, Finance.

title: Volant Manticore: Flying Under the Radar
content: An Iran-nexus threat group named Volant Manticore has been conducting espionage operations since at least September 2025, with links to the Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS). The group shares tooling and tradecraft with MuddyWater but operates independently with custom implants including KuboShell backdoor and the Homa Framework. Cyprus represents the primary target focus, with... This pulse includes 106 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Telecommunications, Transportation, Healthcare. Associated malware: KuboShell, Homa Framework, MuddyC2Go.

title: Vinci RAT Delivered Through a Malicious Microsoft Store App
content: In early November 2026, investigators discovered an intrusion initiated through redirection to a fake snipping tool website, leading to installation of a malicious application called Setup Assistant from the Microsoft Store.
